text:
Why Coyote vs. Acme Only Works As A Live Action/Animated Hybrid
Wearing the influence of Who Framed Roger Rabbit proudly on its sleeve, Coyote vs. Acme is one of the best live-action animated hybrid movies ever. Stars John Cena, Will Forte, Lana Condor, Eric Bauza, and director Dave Green sit down with IGN's Tom Jorgensen to explain their feelings about what makes the hybrid approach so natural a fit for the Looney Tunes and what it was like to find out the movie, which was nearly relegated to being a tax write-off for Warner Bros., would see the light of day after all.

author: IGN YouTube
text:
Metal Gear Solid 4: The Flawed Masterpiece Kojima Didn't Want to Make
Trapped on the dead PS3 no more, Metal Gear Solid 4 is a late 2000s fossil inbound to current-gen hardware and PCs thanks to the Master Collection Volume 2, but is Hideo Kojima's flawed masterpiece, one he didn't even want to make in the first place, still worth playing in 2026? Grab your nanomachine-packed syringe, power on that iPod, and relax, as we sneak our way through a retrospective packed with Old Snake's buttcheeks, military jargon and a boatload of lore. This is Kojima's wayward masterpiece; this is Guns of the Patriots.

The Biggest Game Releases of September 2026
This September has become one of the most jam-packed release windows on record, bringing a non-stop wave of massive blockbusters and cozy indie hits. From Insomniac’s long-awaited take on Wolverine, to nostalgic arcade slashers, and psychological horror, this month has something for every type of gamer. Join IGN’s Max Scoville as he breaks down the biggest titles dropping across all of your favorite gaming platforms in September 2026.

This month’s Biggest Game Releases video highlights major upcoming games including Marvel's Wolverine, The Blood of Dawnwalker, Onimusha: Way of the Sword, Halloween: The Game, Control Resonant, Silent Hill Townfall, Fire Emblem Fortune’s Weave, Dune Awakening, and EA Sports FC 27. We also cover a multitude of indie deckbuilders, cozy management titles, and everything in between. Call of Duty Modern Warfare 4 - Everything You Need to Know About Kill Block
Call of Duty Modern Warfare 4 is introducing a brand new type of map that changes every round. It's called Kill Block, and it works by dividing every map into three modular "slabs" that can be swapped in and out to create an entirely different combination, practically every time you play. Check out this quick explainer running down everything you need to know about it.

text:
GTA 6 Leaks Force Take-Two to File Subpoenas in Federal Court - IGN Daily Fix
In today's Daily Fix:
The recent GTA 6 leaks have forced Rockstar parent company Take-Two to issue subpoenas in federal court. The subpoenas are requesting information from Discord and Microsoft on the 'Cyberleek' group that is behind the leaks. In other news, Microsoft's translucent green Xbox Series X may have had its price revealed, and it won't come cheap. The special edition console will retail for around €899.99, or about $900 USD. The standard 1TB Series X was launched in 2020 for $499 USD. And finally, Dave Bautista is officially confirmed to be taking over the role of Kratos in the God of War series. Ryan Hurst was originally cast and was already filming the first season when he suffered a torn bicep.
